title: ApprovalPolicy (DRAFT)
description: Defines what an approvalPolicy named in permissions.json actually requires. Data rather than code, so a control can be tightened without a release. DRAFT — not approved.

policyCode.description: Matches approvalPolicy in permissions.json — currently dual_control and ai_release_review.

minimumApprovals.description: Approvals required IN ADDITION to the requester's own submission. 1 under dual_control today, giving two distinct people. Raise to 2 once a third authorized person exists.

requesterMayApprove.description: False for any genuine dual control. Setting this true collapses four-eyes to one pair of eyes.

eligibleApproverRoles.description: An EMPTY array means nobody may approve, so the operation keeps refusing. That is the deliberate state of ai_release_review until somebody says who reviews an AI release.

defaultExpiryDays.description: A request pending for months is stale consent.
